title: Craft Blend 3-Mix Duo #13 (KlimtMosaic+RussianPalekh+UkrainianPetrykivka / FrenchLimoges+SpanishAndalusian+PolishBoleslawiec)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult French woman in her early 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair natural skin with a light dewy finish, softly brushed natural brows, a barely-there brown liner and fluttering lashes, no eyeshadow, soft natural colour on the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a single bold classic red lip with a soft matte finish, an unbothered, effortless expression, cheerful, bright golden-blonde hair styled in a short pixie cut, real living eyes. Long round nails, matte finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 3 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Klimt-inspired organic mosaic (an organic mosaic of small irregular tesserae with gold-leaf borders, wide gold bands, dense organic curved mosaic) dominates one zone. Russian Palekh miniature lacquer (a deep black ground with fine gold linework and firebirds, wide gold bands, dense jewel-toned scenework) dominates the second zone. Ukrainian Petrykivka floral painting (a black ground with bright red, orange and gold folk-art flowers, wide gold bands, dense folk-art florals) dominates the third zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.

Left woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto pumps, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Latina woman in her late 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm golden-bronze skin, a sharp black winged liner, warm terracotta eyeshadow, heavy lashes, strong sculpted contour, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep berry lip, a fiery, passionate expression, sultry, bold vivid electric-blue hair styled in elegant updo, real living eyes. Long square nails, holographic finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 3 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. French Limoges enamel (a deep cobalt-blue ground with fine white and gold grisaille scrollwork, wide gold bands, dense grisaille scrollwork) dominates one zone. Spanish Andalusian filigree (a deep black ground with fine silver filigree in geometric star patterns, wide silver bands, dense geometric star filigree) dominates the second zone. Polish Bolesławiec pottery (a deep cobalt ground with bold white peacock-eye dot motifs, wide white bands, dense peacock-eye dot motifs) dominates the third zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: leaning one arm on a window frame.

Center woman's footwear: extreme plain stiletto pumps, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 8K.
